name: Melee Attack
description: Strike with the readied melee weapon: d20 + ability modifier + proficiency bonus against the target's Armor Class. A natural 20 always hits and doubles the weapon dice; a natural 1 always misses. Damage is the weapon's dice plus the same ability modifier (STR, or DEX for finesse weapons).

effects.formula: (save.natural == 20 or (save.success and save.natural != 1)) ? roll(melee.damage) + (save.natural == 20 ? roll(melee.damage) : 0) + melee_mod : 0
